sourceLineage.scope: Public service issue evidence only; no client records, eligibility, credentials, subscribers, or individual financial facts
sourceLineage.authorityNote: Issue existence and JSON Schema validation do not authenticate Group Board authorization or constitute scientific acceptance

cases.science_question: Separately observe AI crawl eligibility, entity resolution, retrieval, citation, factual representation, and customer action. Test whether a six-layer, source-stratified measurement vector predicts independently labelled buyer-task outcomes better than a single composite score under platform/time drift. Pure robots/header/HTTP reachability verification needs no new science and belongs to Engineering tests.
cases.falsifier: Held-out platform/time and blinded task strata show no incremental predictive validity over the prespecified null baseline, or independent annotators cannot reproduce the supposedly observed representation classifications within a preregistered error bound. A provider-reported impression without query context and independent readback fails observation admission.
cases.acceptance: Lenticule independent research receiver approves a fixed sampling frame, annotation codebook, error estimates, platform/time stratification, negative controls, and outcome-linked analysis. Engineering may implement deterministic source/reachability checks now, but no predictive score, paid impact claim, or intervention effect is accepted absent observed evidence.

cases.science_question: Formalize public-program identity, source observations, effective interval, retrieval date, contradictory revision and supersession independently from tenant-local eligibility. Extracting current posted program details against one authoritative source is a deterministic Engineering operation and needs no separate empirical study.
cases.falsifier: A dual-source contradiction, delayed republication, or effective-date reversal is silently treated as a single current rule, or any shared registry test fixture requires a client-specific protected/financial eligibility attribute. Such cases falsify a proposed temporal/evidence model's adequacy.
cases.acceptance: Independent Science receiving checks timeline counterexamples and provenance semantics; Engineering implements observable source IDs, effective intervals, revision/freshness, contradictions and change receipts. Client eligibility facts stay in customer territory and a public program listing never implies award or filing authority.

cases.science_question: Specify a typed authority/state model separating draft preparation, customer review, publication approval, provider draft, send/schedule authorization, public-state observation, correction and customer acceptance. Testing a specific provider receipt field or public URL directly is deterministic Engineering verification; no fresh empirical science is necessary for that subtask.
cases.falsifier: A model transition permits provider send after mere customer review without a distinct send authorization, or equates a provider API success receipt with public publication/reader acceptance. An independently reproduced counterexample invalidates the authority model.
cases.acceptance: Lenticule formally reviews the authority transition model and negative-control counterexamples. Red Cup Engineering can implement deterministic transition/replay tests with explicit customer-scoped authorization and independent public witness; neither Science nor the provider self-accepts the customer's editorial outcome.
